status: Accepted on 2026-10-03; other Node warnings remain outside scope.

approval.scope: Only these four repeated GCC 15 source diagnostics. Preserve normal flags and implementation; no suppression. Other Node/SQLite/V8 warning families remain unresolved.

inspector_vector_insert.root_cause: GCC analyzes the vector range-insertion copy as if it writes into the old two-byte header allocation; std::vector allocates or expands storage to accommodate the inserted range. The insertion uses valid begin/end iterators even for an empty payload.
inspector_vector_insert.control: The exact upstream encoder body reproduces the warning. 1,000 frame cases verify every header length and payload byte at empty, single-byte, 125/126, 65535/65536 and 1 MiB boundaries. Valgrind reports zero errors and all 4,302 allocations freed.

uvwasi_timestamp.root_cause: The stat fallback is read only when neither explicit nor current-time flags are set. That condition necessarily enters the earlier fstat/lstat initialization branch; failed stat returns before either field read. GCC does not carry this combined bitmask condition to the later branch.
uvwasi_timestamp.control: Including the unchanged helper with its real libuv path reproduces the exact warning. All 1,800 combinations across descriptor/path mode and retained/explicit/current access/modification time pass; missing path and closed descriptor fail without modifying outputs. Valgrind reports zero errors and zero definite/indirect/possible losses.
uvwasi_timestamp.control_note: The harness additionally enables -Wextra, which reports unused upstream callback parameters. Those extra harness-only warnings are not requested as package exceptions.
